s.note: Pat tracks Mary down to Miami. Ham, roast pork, swiss and pickles, pressed.
s.how: Split the slab of rolls through the middle and spread both cut sides with mustard. Layer the ham, pork, cheese and pickles on the base and put the top back on. Mix the butter with the garlic and oregano and brush over the top. Cover with baking paper, press down with a heavy tray and bake at 180C until the cheese melts and the tops are crisp. Cut into sliders and serve hot.
shop: 12 soft slider rolls, in one slab@Bakery

s.note: Tucker is really Norm, the pizza boy. Garlic butter knots, parmesan, marinara.
s.how: Cut the dough into 12 strips, roll each into a rope and tie in a loose knot. Prove on a lined tray for 10 minutes, then bake at 220C until golden. Melt the butter with the garlic for a minute and stir in the parsley. Toss the hot knots in the garlic butter and parmesan and serve with warm marinara.

m.note: Franks and beans, yells Warren. Smoky franks, molasses baked beans, slaw.
m.how: Fry the bacon and onion in an ovenproof pot until soft and golden. Stir in the beans, tomatoes, molasses, sugar, mustard, vinegar and water and bring to a simmer. Bake uncovered at 170C, stirring once, until thick and dark. Toss the slaw with the mayo, and grill the franks until blistered. Serve the franks on the beans with slaw alongside.

m.note: The prom Ted never made it to. Ham and swiss chicken, crumbed, mustard cream.
m.how: Cut a deep pocket into each breast and fill with a folded slice of ham and cheese. Dust in flour, dip in egg and press into the panko. Brown in the oil on both sides, then bake at 200C until cooked through. Warm the cream with the mustard and season, and steam the beans. Slice the chicken and serve with the beans and the mustard cream.

w.n: Hair gel meringues with lemon curd
w.note: Mary thinks it's hair gel. Vanilla meringues, whipped cream, lemon curd.
w.how: Whisk the whites to soft peaks, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until thick and glossy. Whisk in the vinegar, cornflour and vanilla and spoon 8 swirled mounds onto lined trays. Bake at 120C until crisp outside, then turn the oven off and let them cool inside. Whip the cream with a little vanilla, and top each meringue with cream, lemon curd and blueberries.

d.note: Mary asks Ted to the prom. Pineapple, ginger beer, rum and lime sorbet.
d.how: Stir the rum, pineapple and lime juice in a punch bowl with ice. Top with the ginger beer. Float the sorbet on top and ladle into cups.
